This document provides provincial-level results for all provinces and the national aggregate not shown in the main text. The Eastern Cape (EC) is presented as the representative example in the main paper; results for all other provinces are shown below.

# Forecast performance

## Free State (FS)

![Forecast performance for the Free State province (FS). The top panel shows the daily (black points) and weekly (red horizontal segments) COVID-19 incidence. The bottom panel displays the Continuous Ranked Probability Score (CRPS) for daily, weekly, and rescaled weekly forecast targets (colours), with both incidence and CRPS shown on a log10 scale. The rows in the bottom panel are faceted by the temporal resolution of the evaluation data (daily or weekly).](../local/figures/fig_panel_scores_FS.png){#fig-panel-scores-FS}

# Computational diagnostics

## Free State (FS)

![Computational diagnostics for the Free State province (FS). The top panel shows the daily and weekly COVID-19 incidence. The middle panel displays the tail Effective Sample Size (ESS) per second on a log10 scale, representing sampling efficiency for different forecast targets (colours). The bottom panel shows the number of model ratchets (adaptive refits) required to achieve convergence for each forecast slide.](../local/figures/fig_panel_diagnostics_FS.png){#fig-panel-diagnostics-FS}
